verdict.rationale: The skill documents two of the story's distribution channels: installing via a Claude plugin marketplace, and copying the folder into a project skills directory, which can be committed to the repo. It also uses the open Agent Skills format, so it works in other skill-capable agents, and it ships a packaging tool for uploads. missing for 10: explicit guidance on team-wide rollout or committing the skill to a shared repo, distribution of a multi-skill standard set rather than one skill, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can distribute a standard skill set to my whole team — via a marketplace, a shared repo, or files committed to the project

citations.quote: Copy the skill folder into your personal (all projects) or project skills directory
The skill uses the open Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md), so it works in any agent that supports skills
